commit_policy.scope: Every POST /api/datasets/<repo>/commit/<branch>, from every worker, failure handler and finalizer
commit_policy.first_commit: Prevalidate local bundle, preupload blobs without repository commits, atomically publish immutable assets + hash partitions + roots + prepared checkpoint/progress at one fixed parent
commit_policy.second_commit: After full fixed-commit real remote consumption, atomically publish verified checkpoint + cumulative progress; only then count rows
commit_policy.on_429: Respect Retry-After/RateLimit reset; wait before using a new owned slot. Never immediate retry or terminate merely on an explicit quota rejection. Wait counts within hard runtime/budget.
commit_policy.on_unknown_commit_outcome: Inspect fixed recipe/checkpoint/asset hashes and exact branch head before deciding whether a retry is safe; unknown outcome stops, no blind replay
commit_policy.critical: Gate the actual commit HTTP request, including SDK/internal writes; pacing outer create_commit calls before slow LFS upload is insufficient
commit_policy.startup: Wait for old write quota to clear before paying for new Jobs; count consolidation writes in the first-hour allowance. New quota errors may move this earliest time later.
